crossRefs.note: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
Yahweh of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women…
For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice…
The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished…

Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city…
Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

I took my staff Favor, and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

translations.web: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’
translations.bsb: Mourn for him, all you who surround him, everyone who knows his name; tell how the mighty scepter is shattered— the glorious staff!
translations.kjv: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
translations.asv: All ye that are round about him, bemoan him, and all ye that know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!
